content.comment_body: This method outlines how to upgrade [product_name] from older Mac operating systems to macOS Monterey (12.4) on Apple Silicon devices. 1. Copy the folder from /Applications/[product_name]_v8.3 and save it to a USB drive. 2. Copy /Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines and save it to the USB drive as well. Then transfer these folders and files to the same locations on the new macOS Monterey system. This provides a working solution for Apple Silicon hardware. I found Java applications and [product_name] run very quickly on this setup. My setup uses a MacBook Pro with Apple Silicon and 32GB of memory.
